item.title: WebGL with three.js
item.description: Everything is moving away from the compiled native app and over to a more naturally cross platform ehh, platform: the web browser. While this has the advantage of (those not using IE) to have the same experience no matter what platform the site (hence to forth to be known as the webapp) is running on. This does still have some limitations. One relitively new api that has come out of this is WebGL
